extracted.name: Luscious Slush Punch
extracted.description: This slushie recipe makes a fruity, fizzy, pineapple-strawberry non-alcoholic punch that kids and adults alike will find refreshingly delicious!
ingredient_lines: 2 (3 ounce) packages strawberry flavored Jell-O® mix
2 (2 liter) bottles lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage
instruction_lines: Bring water, sugar, and strawberry-flavored gelatin to a boil in a large saucepan; boil for 3 minutes. Stir in pineapple juice, lemon juice, and orange juice.
Divide mixture between 2 freezer-safe containers. Cover and freeze until solid, at least 8 hours.
Combine contents of 1 container frozen juice mixture with 1 bottle lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage in a punch bowl; stir until slushy. Repeat with remaining portions as needed.
